subject: reasoning
question:
What will come in the place of ‘?’ in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘ ÷ ‘ are interchanged and ‘ - ’ and ‘ x ’ are interchanged?

 423 + 9 times 19 - 6 div 775 = ?
solution:
423 + 9 × 19 − 6 ÷ 775

Interchange operations:

+ ↔ ÷

− ↔ ×

Replace operators and apply BODMAS rule

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98cf3eb13259193351e719b6e9dcbe7e5db000f4ef6daf1b3969392672dd2d5c.png] 

423 + 9 × 19 − 6 ÷ 775

After interchange:

423 ÷ 9 − 19 × 6 + 775

⇒ 423 ÷ 9 = 47

⇒ 19 × 6 = 114

⇒ 47 − 114 + 775

⇒ −67 + 775

⇒ 708

**∴ Required value = 708.**

Hence the correct answer is option 2.
